Working biography

Biography

A source-led account that distinguishes direct evidence from genealogical information, prior findings, and unresolved identity questions.

Mandatory caveat

The Zürich and Baden-Baden hotel records are strongly compatible, but no source yet directly joins the two careers or links them conclusively to the reported Vienna birth.

Open question Sources: SRC-001, SRC-002, SRC-003, SRC-004, SRC-008, SRC-009, SRC-011, SRC-020

01

Vienna origins

The current dossier contains one cautious working claim about birth. Exact birth and baptism dates, parish, parentage, and address remain unavailable until the original entry is inspected.

CLAIM-BIRTH-VIENNA-1871 User supplied

Genealogical research identifies Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb as born in Vienna in 1871.

Sources: SRC-011

Caution: The original baptismal entry is not incorporated. Do not add an exact date, parish, parents, or address.

02

Zürich and the Savoy-Baur en Ville

Several sources associate the initials S. H. Gottlieb with the hotel. The sequence now includes a verified 1914 guide entry and a verified 1922 listing, but the separate dates do not prove continuous service.

Sources: SRC-001, SRC-002, SRC-003, SRC-004, SRC-019
CLAIM-SAVOY-1911 Previously verified

Earlier research found a 1911 advertisement identifying S. H. Gottlieb as director of Baur en Ville or Savoy.

Sources: SRC-003

Caution: The publication, exact issue date, page, permanent URL, and image or transcription must be reacquired before formal public citation.

CLAIM-BAUR-BIBLOS-OCR Verified direct

A 1914 contemporary travel guide describes S. H. Gottlieb as Direktor of the Savoy-Hotel Baur en Ville in Zürich.

Sources: SRC-004, SRC-019

Caution: This dated point does not prove continuous service from 1911 through 1922 or identify S. H. Gottlieb conclusively with the full-name Baden-Baden hotelier.

CLAIM-BAUR-POSTCARD Verified direct

A cataloged promotional postcard associates the wording 'Direktion S.H. Gottlieb' with Baur en Ville.

Sources: SRC-002

Caution: Do not assign an exact year or infer more than the catalog wording establishes.

CLAIM-SAVOY-1922 Verified direct

A 1922 Swiss travel guide lists S. H. Gottlieb as director of Savoy-Baur en Ville in Zürich.

Sources: SRC-001

Conflicts with: CLAIM-SAVOY-SECONDARY-GOTTLIEB-1910-1918, CLAIM-SAVOY-SECONDARY-GIGER-1918-1926

Caution: This identifies S. H. Gottlieb, but does not by itself prove that he was Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb.

03

The unresolved Savoy chronology

A secondary management sequence conflicts with the direct 1922 listing. The project preserves both accounts and adopts none of the possible explanations without further evidence.

Sources: SRC-001, SRC-018
CLAIM-SAVOY-SECONDARY-DUFFING-1909-1910 Conflicting evidence

A secondary Savoy history assigns Hermann Duffing a management period from 1909 to 1910.

Sources: SRC-018

Caution: This entry is part of the unresolved secondary management chronology and has not been independently verified here.

CLAIM-SAVOY-SECONDARY-GOTTLIEB-1910-1918 Conflicting evidence

A secondary Savoy history assigns a management period from 1910 to 1918 to 'I. Gottlieb'.

Sources: SRC-018

Conflicts with: CLAIM-SAVOY-1922

Caution: Do not change 'I. Gottlieb' to S. H. Gottlieb or assume it is a typographical error.

CLAIM-SAVOY-SECONDARY-GIGER-1918-1926 Conflicting evidence

A secondary Savoy history assigns Fritz Giger a management period from 1918 to 1926.

Sources: SRC-018

Conflicts with: CLAIM-SAVOY-1922

Caution: The dossier does not resolve whether the sources describe different roles, outdated guide information, incorrect dates, or another explanation.

04

A possible later Zürich connection

The 1922 guide names A. Kummer-Wenger with Hotel Victoria. A separate possible Gottlieb connection around 1924 remains unverified.

CLAIM-VICTORIA-1922-KUMMER-WENGER Verified direct

The same 1922 travel guide that lists S. H. Gottlieb at Savoy-Baur en Ville lists Zürich's Hotel Victoria under A. Kummer-Wenger.

Sources: SRC-001

Caution: This does not rule out a different, earlier, later, or subordinate Gottlieb association with a hotel named Victoria; it records only the 1922 listing.

CLAIM-GRAND-VICTORIA-1924 Needs recheck

Earlier research identified a possible 1924 connection between S. H. Gottlieb and Zürich's Grand Hotel Victoria.

Sources: SRC-006

Caution: Do not state that Gottlieb was director of Grand Hotel Victoria in 1924. The original item and his role have not been verified.

05

Baden-Baden and Hotel Messmer

A contemporary notice dated 20 March 1931 gives the full name Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb, calls him a hotelier, and describes him as Pächter—lessee or operator—of Hotel Meßmer. It does not establish ownership of the property. An official historical account's reported 1930 closure conflicts with later directory leads and remains unresolved.

Sources: SRC-007, SRC-008, SRC-009, SRC-020, SRC-021
CLAIM-MESSMER-1929 Indexed lead

Marketplace metadata indicates that a 1929 Hotel Messmer advertisement associated with Gottlieb exists.

Sources: SRC-007

Caution: The listing alone does not establish position, ownership, or the underlying advertisement's wording.

CLAIM-MESSMER-CLOSED-SINCE-1930 Official secondary

An official Baden-Baden historical account reports that Hotel Messmer had been closed since 1930.

Sources: SRC-021

Conflicts with: CLAIM-MESSMER-C1932, CLAIM-MESSMER-1934

Caution: The account's underlying archival files were not inspected. Later directory listings may reflect publication lag, a retained business listing, a discrepancy in the retrospective date, or another unresolved explanation.

CLAIM-SYLVESTER-BADEN-HOTELIER-1931 Verified direct

A contemporary trade newspaper dated 20 March 1931 identifies Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb in Baden-Baden as a hotelier.

Sources: SRC-020

Caution: This full-name Baden-Baden record strongly supports, but does not directly prove, identity with the Zürich hotel director known by initials.

CLAIM-MESSMER-LESSEE-1931 Verified direct

The 20 March 1931 entry describes Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb as Pächter—lessee or operator—of Hotel Meßmer in Baden-Baden.

Sources: SRC-020

Caution: Pächter does not establish ownership of the hotel property.

CLAIM-GOTTLIEB-BANKRUPTCY-AUFHEBUNG-1931 Verified direct

By 20 March 1931, a bankruptcy proceeding concerning hotelier Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb appeared in the Aufhebungen section for the Baden-Baden court district.

Sources: SRC-020

Caution: The notice does not give the reason for termination. Do not infer mangels Masse or any other cause.

CLAIM-MESSMER-C1932 Previously verified

Earlier research found a circa 1932 telephone-directory entry naming S. H. Gottlieb as Inhaber of Hotel Messmer.

Sources: SRC-008

Conflicts with: CLAIM-MESSMER-CLOSED-SINCE-1930

Caution: Reacquire the exact edition, page, column, scan, and wording. Interpret Inhaber in its commercial context.

CLAIM-MESSMER-1934 Previously verified

Earlier research found a 1934 telephone-directory association between Hotel Messmer and S. H. Gottlieb.

Sources: SRC-009

Conflicts with: CLAIM-MESSMER-CLOSED-SINCE-1930

Caution: Do not infer that Gottlieb was alive throughout 1934, personally owned the property, lived at the hotel, or died after a particular date. Directory publication lag is possible.

CLAIM-MESSMER-LASSMANN-PROPERTY Official secondary

An official Baden-Baden historical account associates the Hotel Messmer property with the Lassmann property complex.

Sources: SRC-021

Caution: This does not establish every ownership interest or contractual arrangement, and it reinforces that Gottlieb's documented role should be described as lessee rather than property owner.
